marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Remy is an introverted paramedic who has no luck with the ladies and is always getting bullied by his co-workers. At the same time, he is also short of cash. In other words, Remy is a loser. One day, Remy saves the life of a gang leader named Megat. To repay him, Megat offers Remy a position in his gang. At first, Remy refuses, but after numerous threats, he gives in. Remy, who was once a loser, rises now as a gangster...
